triagePolicy.rule: This queue ranks p.147 pending candidates from same-witness OCR legibility and structural state. Promotion still requires sufficiently stable evidence from ALC1737 itself; OCR is not treated as facsimile-level authority and no secondary witness may silently supply the transcription.

compact_primary_ocr_high_yield.reason: Compact same-witness OCR units offer the highest expected return from a future direct facsimile pass.

wrapped_but_locally_legible.reason: Guide/form evidence is locally coherent but spans OCR line breaks or multi-part microstructure; recollation should reconstruct the historical sequence before promotion.

guide_or_form_materially_ocr_damaged.reason: Primary OCR damage is substantial enough that normalization without direct visual evidence would risk inventing a historical reading.

structural_undersegmentation.reason: Candidate R-020 retains material associated with the following Brincar entry; boundary and transcription need joint facsimile recollation.

nextPassOrder.rationale: Maximum expected number of safe resolutions per direct facsimile inspection.
The text is broadly identifiable; work is mainly line/microstructure reconstruction.
Direct visual evidence is necessary before any textual strengthening.
Requires simultaneous structural and textual recollation rather than simple form reading.

epistemicGuards: This queue changes no transcription and promotes no article.
Same-witness OCR is evidence but is not equated with direct visual collation of ALC1737.
The 36 pending candidates are candidate-level article starts and are not automatically equivalent to 36 missing historical articles.
No precision, recall, or F1 value is claimed while the p.147 visible-start census remains non-exhaustive.

provenance.method: Conservative prioritization of every current p.147 pending_promotion candidate from same-witness OCR legibility and known candidate structure.
